ticket.title: Dispensing: Support limiting prescriptions shown to locations under session's visit location

understanding.intent: Limit the location filter options and visible prescription rows in the dispensing app to locations under the user's session visit location when enabled by configuration.

criteria.text: When limitFilterOptionsBySessionVisitLocation is enabled, the location filter dropdown options are restricted to only locations under the ancestor visit location of the user's session location.
criteria.quote: if true, limits the location selections dropdown to only those under the ancestor visit location for the user’s session location.

criteria.text: When limitFilterOptionsBySessionVisitLocation is enabled, prescription rows shown in the table are limited to locations under the user session's visit location.
criteria.quote: limit prescriptions rows shown to locations under user session’s visit location.

criteria.text: When limitFilterOptionsBySessionVisitLocation is disabled or false, location filter options and prescription rows are not restricted by the session's visit location hierarchy.

questions: What is the default value for limitFilterOptionsBySessionVisitLocation if not specified in the configuration?
understanding.domain_reason: Configuring prescription display and location filtering in the dispensing app is a standard feature of OpenMRS 3.
understanding.reason: Testers can configure the setting, log in to specific locations, and verify the dropdown options and prescription table rows across the Active Prescriptions and All Prescriptions tabs.
